result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: The stated reason for the desert towers was that Uzziah had much livestock. His love of the soil instead explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers. The question should also specify the desert towers, since the window mentions separate towers in Jerusalem and does not call either set “watch towers.”
